title: Justy - just for players!
body:
This simple modpack give you: nice optimization, everything for filming cool videos, and a beautiful picture, and also various conveniences.

The modpack will suit everyone: youtubers, builders, and ordinary players who just want to relax.

Lots of features for playing on a server with friends!

(Its a fully vanilla modpack workable on any server)
